title: Same Word Used as Different Parts of Speech (Ques. No. 1-50)
subtopic: Same Word Used as Different Parts of Speech (79 Marks)

questions.question: He told us about the battle. এখানে about শব্দটি ---[]
questions.explanation: about the battle — battle এর আগে বসে সম্পর্ক বোঝাচ্ছে, তাই preposition

questions.question:
Our blessings come from <u>above.</u> 
Divine inspiration comes from <u>above.</u>[]
questions.explanation: from above = ওপর থেকে (স্বর্গ/উপরের স্থান বোঝাচ্ছে) — এখানে noun হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত।

questions.question:
The heavens are <u>above.</u>
Here 'above' is ---[]
questions.explanation: above কোনো noun কে modify করছে না, শুধু অবস্থান বলছে → adverb।

questions.question: The moral law is <u>above</u> the civil law.[]
questions.explanation:
civil law এর আগে বসে সম্পর্ক দেখাচ্ছে → preposition।
''The civil law''  Noun তাই এর আগে preposition

questions.question: Analyze the <u>above</u> sentences. The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation: above sentences — sentences কে বর্ণনা করছে → adjective।

questions.question: In which sentence 'above' is used as preposition ?[]
options: The moral law is above the civil law.
questions.explanation: Object + Noun এর আগে Preposition

questions.question: <u>After</u> ages will sing his glory. / His <u>after</u> were miserable.[]
questions.explanation: after ages (পরবর্তী যুগ) — ages কে describe করছে → adjective।

questions.question: The patient died after the doctor had come. Here 'after' is ---[]
questions.explanation: after the doctor had come — clause যুক্ত করছে → conjunction।

questions.question: He was <u>all</u> alone when I saw him./ She was <u>all</u> alone when her father died. Here 'all' is -----[]
questions.explanation: all alone — alone কে জোর দিচ্ছে → adverb।

questions.question: He lost his <u>all</u> in speculation.[]
questions.explanation:
his = possessive adjective (determiner)
এটা noun-এর আগে বসে তাকে modify করে।

questions.question: <u>All</u> spoke in his favour.[]
questions.explanation: All এখানে subject হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত → pronoun।

questions.question: <u>All</u> men are mortal.[]
questions.explanation: All men — men কে modify করছে → adjective।

questions.question: Look <u>before</u> you leap. The word 'before' used in the sentence is ---[]
questions.explanation: before you leap — clause যুক্ত করছে → conjunction।

questions.question: I saw him/you once <u>before.</u>[]
questions.explanation: once before — সময় বোঝাচ্ছে → adverb।

questions.question:
He is a <u>better</u> worker than I.
I think yours is a <u>better</u> plan.[]
questions.explanation: Noun কে modify করছে

questions.question:
You should honour your <u>betters.</u>
Give place to your <u>betters.</u>[]
questions.explanation: possessive determiner এর পরে Noum

questions.question: I know him <u>better.</u> Here the word 'better' is ---[]
questions.explanation: know him better — verb কে modify করছে → adverb।

questions.question: Which underlined word is a preposition ?[]
options: None <u>but</u> the brave deserves the fair.
questions.explanation: Object plus Noun এর আগে  preposition

questions.question: But me no <u>buts.</u> The underlined word is a -----[]
questions.explanation: Determiner এরপরে Noun

questions.question: There is no mother <u>but</u> loves her child'. Here 'but' is ---[]
questions.explanation: no mother but loves — but = who does not → negative relative।

questions.question: He came down the hill'. In this sentence 'down' is ---[]
questions.explanation: Obj+ Noun এরাগে preposition

questions.question: Which of the following sentences uses the word 'down' as adverb ?[]
options: The down train has left the station.
questions.explanation: Down went the Royal George — দিক বোঝাচ্ছে → adverb।

questions.question: <u>Either</u> of the two girls will be awarded. The underlined word is -----[]
questions.explanation: দুই জনের মধ্যে একজন → pronoun।

questions.question: He was wise enough to accept the office./ It was wise enough to accept the offer. Here 'enough' is -----.[]
questions.explanation: wise enough — adjective কে modify করছে → adverb।

questions.question: Few know where he is'. Here 'few' is used as -----.[]
questions.explanation: Few know — subject → pronoun।

questions.question: Karim <u>headed</u> the ball.[]
questions.explanation: কাজ বোঝাচ্ছে → verb।

questions.question: They are men of like build and stature. Here the word 'like' is a/an -----.[]
questions.explanation: like build — build কে বর্ণনা করছে।

questions.question: In which of the following sentences 'like' has been used as a preposition ?[]
options: He climbed the tree <u>like</u> a cat.
<u>like</u>-minded people are necessary for a cooperative
questions.explanation: Noun এর  আগে preposition

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is having the word 'like' as adjective ?[]
options: We shall not see his <u>like</u> again.
They are men of <u>like</u> build and stature.
questions.explanation: like’ is used to describe the similarities in build and stature among the men. In this context, it functions as an adjective, giving information about the noun ‘men.’

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is having the word 'near' as adverb ?[]
options: The school is near the post office.
questions.explanation: Verb কে modify করছে

questions.question: There is a big pond <u>near</u> the school.[]
questions.explanation: The + Noun এর আগে preposition

questions.question: Where the word 'Near' is used as preposition ?[]
options: My school was near the mosque.
Death nears with the passage of time.
questions.explanation: The + Noun এর আগে preposition

questions.question: The day of my sister's marriage ceremony is drawing <u>near</u>./ The exam were drawing <u>near</u>. The underlined word is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation: verb কে modify করছে

questions.question: My <u>needs</u> are few.[]
questions.explanation:
Needs Noun
Possesive Determiner এরপর Noun

questions.question: Please take what I have, <u>only</u> let me go.[]
questions.explanation: দুটি clause যুক্ত করছে।

questions.question: He is the <u>only</u> son of his father. Here 'only' is ---[]
questions.explanation: Noun কে modify করছে

questions.question: She did it <u>right.</u> []
questions.explanation: Verb কে modify

questions.question: I cannot <u>right</u> the wrong.[]
questions.explanation: right the wrong — ঠিক করা → verb।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences uses <u>right</u> word as adjective ?[]
options: He is the right man for the job.
It is such a fault that will right itself.
It is a matter of right.
questions.explanation: Man' Noun কে modify করছে

questions.question: Which of the following sentences uses the word 'round' adverb ?[]
options: A square peg in the round hole.
The boy played well in the first round.
At last he came round to their belief.
questions.explanation: verb কে modify  করা হচ্ছে

questions.question: The earth moves <u>round</u> the sun.[]
questions.explanation: The + Noun এর  আগে preposition

questions.question: Which of the following sentences uses the word 'round' adjective ?[]
options: A square peg in a round hole.
The boy played well in the first round.
At last he came round to their belief.
questions.explanation: A+ Adj+ Noun হয়

questions.question: The word 'Still' is used as an adjective in which of the following sentences ?[]
options: He heard a shrill cry in the still of night.
Mothers still their babies with a lulling song.
Mosquitoes lay eggs in still water.
questions.explanation: Water(Noun) er অবস্থা বুঝায়

questions.question: I water in the garden'. / The man is honest'. Here 'the' is ---[]
questions.explanation: Noun কে modify করছে

questions.question: Which of the following sentences uses 'What' as an interrogative adjective ?[]
options: What ! You don't mean to say so.
questions.explanation: What book — book কে modify করছে।

questions.question: Give me what you wish. Here 'what' is used as -----.[]
questions.explanation: Give me what you wish — object হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত।

questions.question: Sit down and rest for a <u>while</u>' / 'I walked for a <u>while</u>'.[]
questions.explanation: a while — noun phrase।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences contains the word 'why' as relative adverb ?[]
options: I don't know the why and wherefore of it.
I don't know the reason why he did it.
questions.explanation: reason why — reason কে modify করছে।

questions.question: He has done no <u>wrong</u>.[]
questions.explanation: Determiner এরপর Noun

questions.question: Do not go in the <u>wrong</u> path.[]
questions.explanation: wrong path — path কে modify করছে।
